place: 北京各高校 → 天安門廣場

title.zh: 悼念活動從校園走向廣場
title.en: Mourning spreads from campuses to the Square

summary.zh: 4 月 17 日起，學生的悼念活動從北京各校園擴散到天安門廣場。遊戲中的具體人物、對話與路線都是虛構的。
summary.en: From 17 April student mourning spread from Beijing campuses to Tiananmen Square. The specific characters, dialogue and route in the game are fictional.

sources.title: The Tiananmen Papers (excerpt: April 17-18)
sources.publisher: The New York Times Books archive
sources.note: The authenticity of some Tiananmen Papers documents has been debated; used here only for the date.

sources.title: The Death That Kindled the Uprising at Tiananmen Square
